note: rapi-red-hood (Rapi: Red Hood — MG/Fire) — whole-kit model; her three skills only make sense together. Pinned line-by-line by scripts/tests/units/rapi-red-hood.test.ts (RRH1-RRH8, both formation branches). || S1 'Combat Assist' is FORMATION-BRANCHED: with NO Burst-1 ally she fills the B1 slot (burstEligibility stage 1) and grants the team burstCdr 7.48s + Attack Damage 8.02%/10s on each full burst (formation 'noB1'); WITH a B1 ally she instead self-buffs ATK 95.04%/10s (formation 'hasB1'). Both branches carry counterfactual pins. || S2: counts as elementally advantaged vs Electric (advantageVs), and carries passive Projectile Attachment Damage 150.72% + Projectile Explosion Damage 100.6%. Its rocket meter is modeled as hitCount 120 (countInFb 60, countInFbStage 3): one rocket per 120 normal attacks, halving to 60 ONLY inside the 10s window of her OWN Stage-3 cast — teammate-opened Full Bursts and her noB1 stage-1 casts run the 120 threshold. Each rocket is a PAIR: an immediate 88.11% attachment hit (flavor projectileAttachment, core TRUE — launchWeapon delivery, band-table rate) and an 88.11% storedHit explosion (flavor projectileExplosion, crit TRUE, instantInFb TRUE). MECHANIC (owner-measured red rocket meter): the meter right of the crosshair fills 0->100%; at 100% one rocket attaches. A rocket attaching DURING Full Burst explodes INSTANTLY; rockets attached OUT of burst do NOT explode until FB begins, so they ACCUMULATE and the first explosion of each FB is a BATCH of all accrued rockets, rendering as exact integer multiples of the single-body value. The meter carries across the FB boundary. || BURST: Stage 1 = self burstCdr 20s + all-ally casterAtkPct 18.01%/10s. Stage 3 = a 2808% FLIGHTED missile (delaySec 0.4 — it lands ~0.4s post-banner INSIDE her own window, so it snapshots at the full buffed state and takes FB +50% and entry auras) and CHARGE-GATED (requiresPulls 120), plus a self Projectile Attachment Damage 421.2%/10s. That 421.2% line is LIVE and formation-gated to her Stage-3 cast; it is what makes an in-window attach body land around 4.4M. || BUCKETS: Projectile Attachment/Explosion Damage compose ADDITIVELY into Damage Up (owner popup ruling; measured non-crit CORE attach 5,057,974 in her B3 window reproduces to -0.24%/+1.1% across buff states). projFactor is a flavor MARKER on the event, not a product factor. || THE EXPLOSION DOES NOT CORE (owner footage ruling, docs/probes probe u7): it is skill damage, and skill damage generally cannot core (U1 function-damage no-core default). storedHit therefore has no core field and no coreOverride — core-ineligible by storedHit default. It DOES crit (storedHit.crit), on the consistency argument that every other hit of hers crits additively at her sheet rate; the stored-hit path's crit-OFF was an artifact exemption, so removing it introduces no new mechanic and no new constant. In-FB explosion body sims 1,192,831 vs a measured 1,195,658 (-0.2%) — the explosion magnitude is confirmed correct and was never the under-modeled carrier. || DELIBERATELY COLD, DO NOT RE-FIT. Her exposed residual is a PREDICTION, not a fit. Part is generic MG-cold (board ~0.947) and part is an OBSERVED-but-unmodeled explosion CRIT magnitude question; the remaining control-comp shortfall is a count/rotation channel (sim 12 FB vs real 13), not instance magnitude — both popup classes match. Do NOT inflate atkPct or re-introduce an explosion core fraction to zero the residual. || ⚑ CARRYOVER SEMANTICS: the 2x-faster in-window meter is modeled as a THRESHOLD switch (120->60), not a +2-fill-per-hit rate. These agree in steady state but differ at the FB boundary (a meter carried in at >=60 can double-fire on entry); rocket count is conserved to O(1), only cross-boundary timing moves. A meter-carryover measurement discriminates them. || ⚑ LEDGERED, does NOT block (open-questions U15): whether the game's crit/core bracket is additive (as the sim models) or multiplicative — the x1.80 core+crit body (7,948,092) does not cleanly compose under additive constants. This applies to ALL 86 board readings, not just explosions; bounded ~0.3-0.4% of her total.
